notes:
Cryogenic microwave cavity LSW experiment constraining hidden sector photon (dark photon) kinetic mixing. Main LSW result: chi < 1.7e-7 at m=53 ueV (mass range 240 MHz to 24 GHz). The paper also reports CDM haloscope bounds at 53 ueV: chi < 6.14e-14 (homogeneous, rho=0.3 GeV/cm^3) and chi < 5.32e-15 (inhomogeneous), which are DM-search results with local density assumption. The primary/headline LSW result is quoted here as it is mass-independent-detector-based bound; the LSW result does not assume DM density. Only the single explicitly quoted LSW point is given as exclusion contour data is a shaded region in Fig 5.
